bio.text: JoCasta Zamarripa, a Democrat, is the Democratic candidate for Wisconsin Secretary of State in the November 3, 2026 general election; the Wisconsin Examiner reports she was unopposed in the Democratic primary.
According to the Examiner, Zamarripa is a second-term Milwaukee alder and a former five-term member of the state Assembly.
